grounding.note: Every case below is presence-grounded (ADR-033 D7a): its expected verdict rests on named entries existing in registry/ and on documents pinned by commit sha in registry/publications.yaml. No case is absence-grounded against a growing corpus, so none requires a pinned fixture under evals/fixtures/. Each case records the ids it depends on, so a future failure is a one-line diagnosis -- the entry moved -- rather than an open question.

evals.prompt: What has Josiah Hagen worked on in CoSAI?
evals.expected_output: Resolves the name to a canonical person id first, then reports the credited publications with the role held on each, and gives affiliation as attested ranges rather than a current employer.
expectations: Resolves the name before answering rather than querying on the raw string
Reports credits per publication with the role held on each
Does not state a current employer anywhere in the answer
Notes that one person can hold several roles on one document

evals.prompt: Where does Josiah Hagen work now?
evals.expected_output: Declines to answer as a current fact. Reports that he was credited under Trend Micro in documents published between 2025-07-14 and 2026-01-08, and without a stated employer as of 2026-09-04, with bounds unknown; and reports the departure as an inferred window (after 2026-01-08, by 2026-09-04) rather than a date.
expectations: States that the graph does not record a current employer
Gives the attested range, not a point-in-time employment claim
Surfaces bounds_known: false or equivalent wording
Reports the affiliation change as an inferred window with notBefore/notAfter, flagged as inferred
Does not interpolate an employer for dates between two attested spans

evals.prompt: Was Bill Stout at ServiceNow in August 2026? The MCP Security paper was revised 12 August 2026 and lists him under ServiceNow.
evals.expected_output: Not asserted. That credit list was carried across the v2.0 revision without being refreshed, so the credit is dated to the original publication date of 2026-01-08, not to the revision date. The row is not evidence of an affiliation in August 2026.
expectations: Answers not-asserted rather than yes
Explains that the credit is dated to the original publication, not the revision
Identifies the revision as not having refreshed the credit list
Does not read the row as a return to a previous employer

evals.prompt: Who were the editors of Zero Trust for AI Systems?
evals.expected_output: Four editors: Jason Garman (Amazon), Igor Pedan (Dell), Bill Stout (independent) and Josiah Hagen (independent). The source document spells one of the two independents 'indepedent'; the canonical organization is reported, and the verbatim spelling is mentioned only if the discrepancy is the point.
expectations: Returns exactly four editors
Reports the canonical organization rather than the verbatim misspelling
Treats the two independents as having no employer rather than an organization named 'indepedent'
Attributes employers as stated on that publication, not as current facts

evals.prompt: Which organization is Akila Srinivasan credited under on the CoSAI Shared Responsibility Framework?
evals.expected_output: Not David LaBianca, and not Jodi Middleton. Those are two other people named on the same line of the source document. A line naming several people must have its arity resolved before it is split, or the second name is read as the first person's employer.
expectations: Does not report a person's name as an organization
Recognises that several people share one source line
Reports her roles on that document without collapsing them, as she holds two

evals.prompt: Who contributed to the Addendum on Post-Quantum Cryptography for MCP?
evals.expected_output: Nobody is credited: at the pinned revision that document carries no acknowledgements section. Zero credits is the correct answer for it, not a retrieval gap or an error.
expectations: Answers zero credits without reporting a failure or a gap
Explains that the document has no acknowledgements section
Does not fall back to naming contributors of the parent MCP Security paper

evals.prompt: Who wrote the agent containment paper, and can I cite them as CoSAI authors?
evals.expected_output: Reports the credits and states that the document is a working draft, so credit on it is not approved CoSAI work and should not be cited as such.
expectations: Surfaces the approval status alongside the credits
Warns that credit on an unapproved draft is not approved CoSAI work
Does not present draft credits as equivalent to credits on an approved publication
